caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or weaving sample with a predominantly blue background and geometric patterns in orange and lighter blue. The upper section consists of a tightly woven fabric featuring three central horizontal, stepped motifs in orange, each separated by light blue zigzag lines. On both the left and right sides, there are four stacked triangular orange shapes, outlined with connecting light blue lines, forming a symmetrical arrangement. Below the woven section, numerous vertical strands of yarn hang freely in thick, wavy lines, alternating between blue and orange, creating a fringe effect that extends downward. The whole composition is centrally placed on a light beige background.
title: Coverlet Detail
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
